$comment: Single source of truth for the website's languages. To add a language:
1. add one entry here (key = locale code used in URLs and file names, e.g. intro.de.mdx);
2. add an optional partial dictionary in lib/i18n/dictionary.ts (missing keys fall back to English);
3. translate docs pages as <path>.<code>.mdx. With docs: "optional" a language may start with zero pages:
untranslated pages fall back to English with a notice. Set docs: "required" only when every page must exist.
ogLocale is the Open Graph tag (en_US), intlLocale is the BCP 47 tag used for dates (en-US),
rtl marks right-to-left scripts and sets dir="rtl" on <html> (layout mirroring for RTL is tracked separately).
